titre: Contrôler les accès avec GRANT et REVOKE

[cheerful] New lesson: controlling access with grant and revoke.

Control who can read or change the data with access permissions.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] Since the start of module 8, you’ve been building the database for NutriBoost’s wellness workshops.

In the previous lesson, an index sped up the order search.

NutriBoost’s management screen shows the orders, the products and the customer records.

A new colleague has to prepare the packages.

But with an account that’s too broad, she could also, by accident, change prices or delete customers.

Camille Roux, head of operations, is writing to you.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] Here you reuse the idea of a view, from the CREATE VIEW lesson.

A view is a query saved under a name.

The information Lina needs is in the orders table and the customers table.

These tables also hold data she doesn’t need to see, like the email or the phone number.

A view shows her only what she needs, without opening up the whole tables.

A shipping underscore orders view has been prepared.

It holds only these four columns.

The view doesn’t copy the data: it reads them from the tables each time it’s read.

Lina needs the recipient and the address to prepare the packages.

This view gathers the information useful for her work.

Her account is already created and has, for now, no access to the tables.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] Your mission: allow Lina to read the view.

Click the “Run” button.

On Lina’s sheet, reading is now allowed.

Lina opens the shipments list: the view’s rows show up.

GRANT grants a permission.

Here, select allows Lina to read the shipping underscore orders view.

ON sets the view, and TO the account that gets the permission.

Your turn!

elements.texte:
[cheerful] Lina now tries to change a product’s price.

When she clicks “Save”, her app writes an SQL query.

Her app sends the query to the database, with Lina’s account.

Your turn!

The database checks the permissions before running the action.

Since Lina isn’t allowed to change products, the price stays the same.

[cheerful] A month later, Lina’s assignment ends.

Your turn!

You write a REVOKE for each permission granted.

With REVOKE, the account comes after the keyword from.

Run both commands: click “Run”.

REVOKE revokes a granted permission.

Here, you revoke the two permissions given to Lina at the start of her assignment.
